# Credit backed by Trust

Union is an open-source protocol enabling onchain access to peer-to-peer credit.

No Collateral

No Credit Score

No Middlemen

[Get Started](https://app.union.finance/)

[Book a Demo](https://app.deform.cc/form/71614be7-c4c6-4d02-9364-2971833e287b)

Backed By

## Give Credit. Get Credit.

Fund what matters with those you trust

[Your personal credit line Build a personal on-chain credit line with vouches from those who trust you. Draw from that credit line whenever you need](https://docs.union.finance/developers/union-sdk)

[Permissionlessly lend to who you trust Vouch to a selection of your trusted contacts to extend them a line of credit and add to their credit line](https://docs.union.finance/developers/peripheral-and-fun-contracts)

## How Union works

Union introduces new ways to gain access to credit, starting with nothing more than an Ethereum address

Stake

Permissionlessly deposit stablecoins and earn UNION tokens for backing those you trust.

Vouch

Underwrite who you trust the most, give them a fair line of credit, and earn when they borrow.

Borrow

Use your onchain credit line permissionlessly from anywhere in the world. 

Vote

All parameters on Union including the Rate are determined democratically by the users.

## Build your future with Union

On Union you can trust anyone. And anyone can build credit by asking others to vouch for them.

For Personal Use

Free your friends from extractive lenders, back them directly in the first p2p onchain credit protocol. [Use App](https://app.union.finance)

For Business Use

Credit is vital to small businesses. Interested in seeing how Union can lower your cost of capital? [Let's Talk](https://app.deform.cc/form/71614be7-c4c6-4d02-9364-2971833e287b)

For Developers

Union is onchain programmable credit, you can borrow and lend directly from a smart contract.[Github](http://github.com/unioncredit)

## Get Involved

[Deploy a Contract that vouches for holders of a specific NFT Build with Union](https://docs.union.finance/developers/union-sdk)

[Vote on proposals All aspects of the protocol are set by holders of UNION tokens earned by using the protocol. Governance Forum](https://docs.union.finance/developers/union-sdk)

## Union News

[Announcing TrustFallGa.me : an onchain PvP & CoOp game Union July 16 Embrace the thrill of trust-based finance in the Trustfall: a game of alliances, risks, and rewards. Trustfall interweaves collective strategy and individual audacity, as players Read More Mint](https://union.mirror.xyz/Fp7gWLvB1uqo5p-btVep52SZ6jafwkqTeH6CrSO4gFI)

[Union v2, Live on optimism Union April 28 Union, A member owned credit network where any address can permissionlessly underwrite any address, is excited to announce it has deploy version 2 of its protocol to optimism Read More Mint](https://union.mirror.xyz/uPnUm4TLNyWoRfNAVCJwxT0TeNPBgNCg04vuDv5sIGk)

[View All](https://union.mirror.xyz/)

Credit is more than a tool for speculation

Credit turns idle money into the productive capital that's used to buy the materials and services that create the products and services we all use.

If you have a need but lack funds, credit connects those with cash and no ideas with those with ideas but no cash, fueling economic growth by putting money to work.

The ability to access credit is a powerful guiding force to what ideas get funded, can be the difference between an emergency expense being painful to fatal, and even what type of business can afford to operate.

Too critical to remain a monopoly.

We built Union, a peer-to-peer credit layer to empower everyone to underwrite what they want based on what matters to them.Democratizing access to credit.

Union empowers you to own your risk and lend to any trusted friend, developers to build on programmable credit lines, and robots the ability to underwrite and borrow onchain same as a human.

Underwrite the future you want to see...with those you trust!

\-signed,

Union Devs

devdoc.details: This contract implements an upgradeable proxy. It is upgradeable because calls are delegated to an implementation address that can be changed. This address is stored in storage in the location specified by https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1967[EIP1967], so that it doesn't conflict with the storage layout of the implementation behind the proxy.

constructor.details: Initializes the upgradeable proxy with an initial implementation specified by `_logic`. If `_data` is nonempty, it's used as data in a delegate call to `_logic`. This will typically be an encoded function call, and allows initializing the storage of the proxy like a Solidity constructor.

devdoc.details: This contract implements an upgradeable proxy. It is upgradeable because calls are delegated to an implementation address that can be changed. This address is stored in storage in the location specified by https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1967[EIP1967], so that it doesn't conflict with the storage layout of the implementation behind the proxy.

constructor.details: Initializes the upgradeable proxy with an initial implementation specified by `_logic`. If `_data` is nonempty, it's used as data in a delegate call to `_logic`. This will typically be an encoded function call, and allows initializing the storage of the proxy like a Solidity constructor.
